question.:question/worked-solution:
Here, we have the product of the two functions $u(x)=x$ and $v(x)=\cos{\left(x \right)}.$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}(u(x)v(x))' &=u'(x)\cdot v(x)+u(x)\cdot v'(x) \\ &=(x)'\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)}) \\ &\quad +(x)\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)})' \\ &=(1)(\cos{\left(x \right)}) \\ &\quad +(x)(- \sin{\left(x \right)}) \\ &=\cos{\left(x \right)} \\ &\quad +(- x \sin{\left(x \right)})\end{aligned}
$$

generation.domain: real x where the factors are differentiable

$$
